task: Core #1272 CLOSE/LEARN: add canonical General Known Failure for PO decision provenance/supersession loss

assuranceCeiling.rationale: High assurance needed because every subsequent Core module depends on correct, bounded Product Owner source and instruction precedence. Recurring provenance loss can silently cause incorrect Alap/Pro capabilities or merchant opt-outs. This changes only existing canonical Knowledge+Policy+tests, with global preventive reading but no global runtime blockage or speculative autoactivation. Exact-head negative/positive tests and full CI/lifecycle required.

acceptanceCriteria: Add General Known Failure SQ-KF-025 recording PO decision provenance/source/supersession loss and source-to-scope-to-instruction chain, with explicit original #1272 source records.
Add a single canonical preventative directive in existing Development Guard Policy, forbidding unsourced plan contradictions, outdated generic overrides and unverified source autoactivation.
Add General Negative Knowledge SQ-NK-024 linked to authoritative #1272 audit, with applicability matched to the quality-system workflow.
Wire the new failure into global baseline preventive injection across unrelated Core module changes, without triggering unrelated capability modifications or auto-installing rules.
Add executable regression checks for knowledge integrity, source/scope/precedence rules, directive parity, global applicability and unrelated storefront/edit scope.
Retain the five existing machine PO instructions and the 16 adversarial PO plan tests unchanged; no new NLP claim, no runtime product entitlement adjustment.
Run exact-branch-plan guard before edits, then true CI 3534+ test/typecheck/build, Completion Truth and Lifecycle closure, and merge before resolving issue #1272.
invariants: No parallel PO authority, separate gate engine or source ingestion pipeline.
Only explicit PO-accepted source may create an active machine rule; historical 108 index slots with UNKNOWN/REJECTED remain reference-only.
Later explicit, scoped PO acceptance overrides earlier generic summaries; missing source context is REVIEW_REQUIRED/BLOCK for relevant plan, not fabricated acceptance.
General Known Failure knowledge injects a preventive directive and relevant tests, not unconditional rejection of unrelated code/doc changes.
Existing global baseline and dynamic Known Failure integrity schema remain valid; every global failure has exactly one directive.
No runtime/customer/tenant/migration/provider/funding resource, no Template Factory/Builder product work and no change of Core-first sequencing.
